scientific_integrity: Exact finite-dimensional spectral proof. Exact absorption statements apply only to the declared adjacency-driven unweighted single-particle model; no independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: No statement about finite-time decay or mean absorption times, weighted/disordered/magnetic ladders, multiple absorbers, or arbitrary graph families. Published-priority investigation is nonexhaustive.
title: Arithmetic resonance and perfect rung-to-rung absorption on cyclic quantum ladders
